description: Every WorldAPI token (never the secret itself): name, groups and permissions, what they resolve to, origin, creator, expiry. `groups` adds every group and permission with what it allows. `audit` answers instead what clients changed through WorldAPI, newest first: who (a token or `panel:<account>`), when, method, path, target, status, and details. Tokens are made in game (/worldapi token create) or WorldAPI's admin panel.
name: list_tokens
title: WorldAPI tokens and audit log
